channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: Around the world bikepacker killed by suspected lightning strike in Andes
item.description: Florian Berg was more than a year into his adventure aiming to highlight "the existential danger of climate change"

item.title: "If you build it, they will come... or maybe not," says local news site after spotting cyclists not using new cycle lane; "Wow... just wow": Bike shop mechanic discovers a whole new level of wear; Tour Down Under destruction + more on the live blog
item.description: The weekend countdown is on and Dan Alexander is in the building to take you one day closer with some fantastic cycling-related procrastination material for your Thursday

item.title: Rad Power Yikes: Fire breaks out at troubled US e-bike brand’s warehouse
item.description: After refusing a recall over fire safety concerns, the US e-bike giant’s own facility goes up in smoke

item.title: Boardman Mens Long Sleeve Jersey
item.description: Solid budget jersey ruined by poor shaping and the bad fit that results 4/10

item.title: On-the-fly tyre pressure adjustment innovator Gravaa declared bankrupt due to lack of sales – nine months after Paris-Roubaix triumph
item.description: The Dutch company pioneered the self-inflating and deflating tyre technology used by Pauline Ferrand-Prévot to win Paris-Roubaix last year, but says it has struggled to “get enough orders to make any margin in the current market”

item.title: Sam Bennett undergoes heart surgery after health scare: “I had palpitations, I didn’t know what was going on”
item.description: In an in-depth interview with road.cc, the Irish sprinter and former Tour de France green jersey winner reveals the heart issue may have been holding him back for years, admitting it’s “possible I was having mini episodes during sprints”

item.title: road.cc Dealclincher takeover: Save over £4,000 on the Giant TCR Advanced, huge 72% off Pro Expert Toolkit, up to 55% off Rapha winter kit, £5 Vel saddlebags + more
item.description: Big late January payday savings are here with massive discounts on bikes, tools, kit and loads more

item.title: “Our safe streets are here to stay”: Mayor’s “dangerous” decision to axe low traffic neighbourhoods deemed unlawful, as campaigners hail “huge precedent for London”
item.description: The Court of Appeal ruled the removal of three liveable streets in Tower Hamlets by its mayor Lutfur Rahman failed to implement Sadiq Khan’s transport strategy for London, after years of legal wrangling

item.title: Banned driver avoids jail after hitting 10-year-old cyclist while overtaking bus on wrong side of road in series of “spectacularly stupid, immature, and reckless decisions”
item.description: The motorist, who was banned from driving following a speeding offence at the time of the collision, was handed another 12-month suspension and ordered to pay £2,000 in compensation

item.title: New Jersey blanket e-bike law will remove “a viable alternative to cars from the road”
item.description: All e-bikers in the US state will require a licence, registration and insurance from this summer. What could go wrong?
